decisions.reason: As a multi-model executive desk system tied closely to the firm's core office range and stated move toward flexible workplace interiors, it carries substantial sunk development and marketing investment that management is likely to continue defending.

The chair family is a close extension of the established assortment with visible prior commitment, so after several years on the market management would be inclined to justify and retain it rather than reverse course.

These floor cushions remain the most niche of the surviving products, but because they still support the broader design-led interiors concept and already absorbed range-building effort, management is more likely to keep them than to withdraw them.

The sofa had weaker initial public prominence than the other launches, yet its closeness to the firm's living and lounge business and the tendency to persist with existing commitments still point to continued support.

The high standing table fits the firm's direction toward adaptable residential and workplace settings, and the accumulated investment in a dedicated, contemporary product concept makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.
